title: fix(searchbox): update usage errors
body:
This updates the usage errors messages for `searchBox`.

- `input`s are not valid containers anymore
- `autofocus` used to accept string values for `"auto"`, which is not a valid value for the HTML attribute `autofocus`.

> Related: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/3127#pullrequestreview-195958590
